items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Spud had written most of those arrangements.

ctx.x: And Spud had written most of those arrangements. It was a sort of a pseudo-swing band, you know. It wasn't the -- the only part was that Spud never wrote any parts for himself, because he had them in his head, having written the arrangements. And I got all of these arrangements. I was able to -- oh, there must have been a couple of hundred arrangements. There was a trunk full of
music and -- every one -- I got maybe 25 arrangements out of there that were playable, because -- that Spud hadn't written.
